low.observation: After the learner selects a wrong-answer diagnosis reason, the existing reason-chip callback rerenders renderBFinalResult(a,0). The result message therefore changes from the already-earned XP amount to +0 XP even though the attempt score and persisted XP award are not undone.
low.learner_risk: This is display-only, but it can make the newly promoted recovery interaction look as if the learner lost the XP they just earned and weakens trust in the result screen.
low.recommended_repair: Preserve the original earned-XP display value across same-attempt result rerenders. Keep reason persistence, review-open state, scoring and profile XP logic unchanged.
